_readme: Round 8 (item 6): the checked-in allowlist of every declined_cases.json row whose on-device (device) or server (server) outcome knowingly differs from its true outcome (expect), or that is a pinned open defect (defect). Both table tests (app/test/engine/parser/declined_state_cues_table_test.dart, process-ios-sms/parse_test.ts) fail unless the set of deviating rows, with their device/server/defect values, equals this list and count. A completed row may deviate only to a more visible unrecorded outcome (device review / not_completed / transfer; server unresolved / not_completed / review = rejected with the device's own review row), never ignored, never another amount, never the opposite direction; 'dropped' (no amount read, a bank sender's Smart Inbox card) or another recorded type in the same direction is allowed (round 9). Round 10: Q's probes (V1-RES10) are added with their hand truth; an outcome the code still gets wrong on them (as at ab5dc10a or better) is pinned as an open defect (defect = 'OPEN ...'), and only those rows may carry one.
